notes.title: INCOMING v2.2 is now LIVE
notes.content:
[IMG]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/510405794955104530/97372832C66881BC971804BDE850FF484FFA5CD9/[/IMG]

[B]Patch Notes v2.2[/b]
 
[*]Added the Boost button to unit training, unit promotion, supply production and upgrading buildings to speed them up for a small amount of gold
[*]Added left and right buttons to the unit training to quickly switch between buildings
[*]Replaced the Rivals list on all platforms with the Friends list from the Xbox One version
[*]Removed the attack button from the list of alliance members
[*]Fixed an issue where some players didn’t receive their weekly gold reward from the Friends list
[*]Fixed the issue where it was possible to train aircraft in the wrong buildings
[*]Fixed the pink shadow on the Paratroopers
 
[b]Rebalancing Updates[/b]
[*]Increased the Medi-Drop’s range, healing power and duration and decreased its cost
[*]Increased the Supply reward from Campaign missions
[*]Decreased the cost of Fortifications
[*]Decreased XP rewarded for training troops
[*]Decreased the Artillery Strike's damage

notes.title: INCOMING! Version 2.1 is now live
notes.content:
[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/646628456472513722/3D8BB44C4A0F3E3368AFAB51C96D4FC1C59836E5/[/img]

This is another massive update with lots of new features, as well as bringing all platforms into line with each 
other. Players not on Xbox One now have all the same, new units, including the Elite Ranger! 
There’s a fun festive theme for the holidays too. As well as updating the Christmas Tree, we have introduced The Snowman!

We’ve also incorporated a lot of player feedback into our unit re-balance, which will help you get the most out of 
all your units’ attacking and defensive capabilities. For a full change log check out our new [url=http://battleislands.wikia.com/wiki/Version_History]Patch Notes[/url]

Make sure you’ve updated to the latest version, and be sure to tell us what you think.
Players who are on Xbox One - your holiday edition will be following shortly. Watch this space!

INCOMING! Version 1.10 is live now on Steam. 
· Store landmarks - Players can now add customisation to their base by storing away landmarks they've built but might not want to appear. The item will go back to the shop and can be built again any time for free.
· Bug fixes – We've addressed an issue where some players were being disconnected from their Facebook account without knowing it, and added significant improvements to stability and loading speeds of the game during World War events.

notes.title: Incoming! Version 1.9 is now live
notes.content:
[img]https://fbcdn-sphotos-f-a.akamaihd.net/hphotos-ak-xfp1/v/t1.0-9/s720x720/10176076_555467777930625_2023848682288926368_n.jpg?oh=1dd330e8306ee1032d35876708f2e353&oe=54FB74A5&__gda__=1430253717_e36bf16c351228bba7f9b16f12bb94d6[/img]

The holiday season is here but don't expect a ceasefire any time soon! Instead, count on plenty of support from back home with gift drops for frontline troops, festive combat attire and a special 12 Days of Christmas event!

Is the smell of napalm dampening your Christmas morning? Upgrade your Command Bunker to Rank 9 and gain access to extra Oil Rigs, Shipyards, Airfields and more!

Shove this in your enemy's stocking - the new Gun Turret is available from level 6 and above, giving you some serious point-defense capability! Don't let the fire rate fool you - this beauty packs a punch!

Loyalty counts in this army, son. Expect increased rewards and bonuses when you log in regularly!

The enemy never sleeps and neither do your command staff. They've been working hard to improve the stability and effectiveness of your battle systems but remember, they need the help of every active commander to stay on top!

notes.title: INCOMING 1.8 is now Live!
notes.content:
[IMG]https://scontent-a-lhr.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xfp1/v/t1.0-9/s720x720/1508974_539321016211968_4893830816840436048_n.jpg?oh=5182a6f203f066d402236b23b7694f5d&oe=551CCF38[/IMG]

Ten-hut, 
 
We shipping over a substantial resupply package, including several upgrades to your logistical and combat systems.
 
Expect a war and expect it soon. The battlefield is always changing and soon your men will have to face World War across the entire theatre of operations! Of course, with more action comes greater need for logistics and with new support tools at their disposal, your men will receive the assistance they need to get back into the fight.
 
Last inspection showed some of your recruits were sorely lacking in teamwork. Improve that right away with the new multiplayer tutorial, a basic training regimen that will get your new commanders working as a unit in no time. To this end, communications have been improved, and with the new additions to the chat systems, allies will be able to co-ordinate their strikes better than ever!
 
 To all commanders out there: keep your boots clean, your bayonets sharp and your rifles down-range. HQ out!

notes.title: Its time for Battle, Soldier!
notes.content:
The year: summer of 1942. The theatre of operations: an undisclosed chain of tropical islands in the South Pacific. Your mission: to seize these strategically critical islands, establish a base and hold your ground in the face of overwhelming odds.

You will not be alone. At your command will be some of the hardest-fighting leathernecks in the service, and you’ll have the finest military hardware at your disposal to bring about total victory. Fight with (or against) your friends and show them what makes the grass grow!

[list]
   [*]Master the art of offence and defence in this action-packed WWII-themed strategy game
   [*]Deploy units on land, sea and air
   [*]Build up and fortify your island garrison with everything from machine guns and land mines to howitzers!
   [*]Form Alliances with friends and earn your place on the leader board!
   [*]If someone hits you, hit him harder! Keep track of your rivals and choose your moment to strike!
   [*]Unprecedented multiplayer support - fight against users on iOS and Android!
   [*]Engage your enemy across platforms! Play on Steam at home and your mobile device when on manoeuvres - Battle Islands is supported on iOS, Android and Amazon!
   [*]Join a growing, thriving community of fellow commanders and benefit from the supreme knowledge of our very own Sarge!
   [*]Beautiful graphics custom-built for Steam
[/list]

Your mission will not be easy. Your enemy is well trained, well equipped and battle-hardened. They will fight savagely. You must fight them on the beaches. You must fight them on the landing grounds, on the fields and in the hills.

[b]You must never surrender![/b]
